## Motivation

Add an opt-in Gluon/Triton FAv3 attention backend for AMD gfx1250 in SGLang Diffusion. It supports **BF16 and FP16, head dimensions 64/128/256, dense noncausal MHA, zero dropout, and rectangular Q/KV lengths**. Dispatch uses tensor properties and device occupancy; it does not depend on a model identifier.

Select it with `--attention-backend gluon_fav3`. AITER remains the ROCm default. Unsupported dense contracts reaching the backend use AITER; shared masked-attention routing may use SDPA.

## Modifications

- Add stable pipeline and ping-pong schedules with FP32 softmax state and round-to-nearest probability conversion to the input dtype. D256 uses the four-wave pipeline to avoid the severe register-spill slowdown of the wide tile.
- Use default scheduling and full TDM waits before reading pipeline K/V tiles for FP16. Automatic `max-ilp` intermittently corrupted storage-offset inputs; disabling it alone still failed for D64. Full waits also protect explicitly configured FP16 pipeline launches. The underlying compiler/synchronization defect remains unresolved.
- Preserve BF16/D128 persistent K/V reuse for eligible contiguous short-KV inputs and input-checked optimizations for long attention. GPU checks rerun on every CUDA graph replay. FP16 and other dimensions use stable generic softmax; the BF16 fixed shift would underflow FP16 probabilities.
- Replace the former model-specific fixed-shift environment opt-in with guarded dispatch and numerical fallbacks. Retain 64-bit tile-base addressing, independent tensor strides, partial tiles, and custom softmax scale.
- Integrate the measured TokenSpeed-derived stride specialization and earlier first-block maxima in persistent cross attention. Variants that failed numerical checks or regressed performance are excluded.
- Preserve explicit backend identity, check required Gluon/TDM APIs, and retain fallback configuration.
- Add dtype/head-size benchmark arguments and independent FP64 checks for selected providers. Automatic benchmarks now exercise the production automatic dispatch.

## Accuracy Tests

**243 tests passed** under the actual host `gpu-lock`, covering:

- `test/registered/amd/test_gluon_fav3_gfx1250.py`
- `python/sglang/multimodal_gen/test/unit/test_gluon_fav3_backend.py`
- `python/sglang/multimodal_gen/test/unit/test_aiter_attention_impl.py`

New coverage includes both dtypes and all three head sizes, both generic schedules, tails, independent sliced/transposed inputs, custom scale, large positive/negative uniform logits, late outliers, automatic short-KV dispatch, and a 65,536-token FP16 underflow regression. Existing graph-replay guards and addressing tests remain covered.

The review fix adds 12 repeated automatic FP16 pipeline cases: D64/D128/D256 with one-element storage offsets on Q, K, V, or all three. All 500 launches per case pass independent full-output FP64 attention checks (6,000 launches total). Supplemental graph validation passes 3,000 replays across all three head sizes, using both automatic dispatch and explicitly requested `max-ilp`. The reviewer's exact reproducer also passes 100/100 offset-input launches after the fix.

All 12 dtype/head-size/self-or-cross benchmark cases pass independent sampled FP64 attention over all keys. Relative RMS thresholds are 0.003 for BF16 and 0.001 for FP16, with a separate pointwise error check. At `e49fd55ce35a`, full outputs on all four original BF16/D128 targets were also bitwise identical to the saved previous implementation. The review fix changes FP16 pipeline scheduling/synchronization; BF16 and ping-pong/persistent schedules retain their existing waits.

The PR is rebased onto main at `c15edf314d20`. All 243 tests and all 12 dtype/head-size benchmark cases pass on review-fix commit `91033140f0`.

Validation uses synthetic tensors; no model weights or full generation. Pre-commit passes. Mintlify site validation could not run because the container lacks Node and `mint`.

These are local gfx1250 validation results. No checked-in workflow currently invokes the registered `nightly-amd-1-gpu-mi45x` suite. Full-model generation quality, multi-GPU execution, and independent performance verification remain outside this validation.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

Regression measurements at `e49fd55ce35a` use BF16, H40, D128, Sq176400; self attention has Sk176400 and cross attention Sk512. These timings predate the FP16 pipeline review fix; the BF16/D128 schedules below are unchanged.

| Attention | Batch | Gluon ms | AITER assembly ms | Latency reduction |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| self | 1 | 273.682 | 276.516 | 1.02% |
| self | 2 | 548.163 | 569.013 | 3.66% |
| cross | 1 | 1.180 | 1.206 | 2.11% |
| cross | 2 | 2.352 | 2.403 | 2.15% |

Measured on gfx1250 with PyTorch `2.11.0+rocm10.0.0`, Triton `76940ad348795521b3dc9f6c79acd7309ff924e3`, and AITER `a6d2b564fd671724a3720b8edf70e8d674e4d694`. The shared AITER checkout contains pre-existing edits; this change does not modify it. The direct baseline is `fmha_fwd_with_sink_asm`, using default scale, noncausal attention, and no LSE.

All GPU runs use `/usr/local/bin/gpu-lock docker exec sglang-fav3-goal2 ...` and dynamic clocks. The table uses seed 907 and six paired rounds with alternating order and balanced warmups. Each graph contains two calls; each measurement uses eight replays for B1 self attention, two for B2 self attention, and twenty for cross attention. Each case wins all six paired assembly comparisons; maximum provider CV is below 1%. GPU guards are included; host Python/allocation overhead is excluded. Two noisy short-window B1 self trials are retained; the complete case was repeated with a longer timing window.

The D256 pipeline avoids the severe register-spill cost of the initial wide-tile generalization. Fresh measurements after the review fix use B1/Sq8192/Sk8192/H16 for self attention and B1/Sq32768/Sk512/H40 for cross attention:

| D256 dtype | Self ms | Cross ms |
|---|---:|---:|
| BF16 | 0.587 | 0.629 |
| FP16 | 0.974 | 0.908 |

The conservative FP16 synchronization costs performance: earlier FP16 pipeline measurements were 0.621 ms self and 0.689 ms cross. These are separate dynamic-clock runs, not a paired before/after comparison. These are not AITER speedup claims: the installed AITER API rejects the tested FP16 and D64/D256 inputs. The smaller BF16/D128 cases also remain slower than AITER. Performance wins are limited to the four original target shapes, not every supported contract or end-to-end generation.

The maintained benchmark supports `--dtype {bf16,fp16}`, `--head-size {64,128,256}`, `--preset wan-self` / `wan-cross`, and `--batch`. Use `--provider gluon` for combinations unsupported by the installed AITER build; FP64 correctness checks still run.

## Checklist

- [x] Pre-commit checks pass.
- [x] 243 unit and registered GPU tests pass under the shared GPU lock.
- [x] Validate 6,000 repeated FP16 offset-input launches and 3,000 graph replays.
- [x] Add independent FP64 and full-output regression checks.
- [x] Document supported contracts, dispatch, compiler requirements, and benchmark options.
- [x] Preserve the ROCm default and existing fallback routing.

@@ -0,0 +1,346 @@
+"""Correctness-gated AITER vs BF16/FP16 Gluon FAv3 benchmark on gfx1250."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import argparse
+import json
+import os
+import platform
+import statistics
+import subprocess
+from pathlib import Path
+
+import aiter
+import torch
+import triton
+from aiter.jit.core import ENABLE_CK
+
+from sglang.kernels.ops.attention.gluon_fav3_gfx1250 import (
+    FAv3LaunchConfig,
+    gluon_fav3_attention,
+    select_fav3_launch_config,
+)
+
+PRESETS = {
+    "reference": (1, 8192, 8192, 16),
+    # One Wan2.2-T2V-A14B request at 720x1280x193: 49*45*80 tokens.
+    # Conditional and unconditional CFG branches run in separate B1 calls.
+    "wan-cross": (1, 176_400, 512, 40),
+    "wan-self": (1, 176_400, 176_400, 40),
+}
+
+
+def aiter_attention(query, key, value):
+    """Match AITerImpl, including its BF16 conversion setting."""
+    return aiter.flash_attn_func(
+        query,
+        key,
+        value,
+        dropout_p=0.0,
+        softmax_scale=query.shape[-1] ** -0.5,
+        causal=False,
+        return_attn_probs=False,
+        return_lse=False,
+        how_v3_bf16_cvt=2,
+    )
+
+
+def check_sampled_fp64(query, key, value, outputs):
+    """Check selected batch/head/query positions against all keys in FP64."""
+    batch, seqlen_q, num_heads, head_size = query.shape
+    batches = torch.tensor(sorted({0, batch - 1}), device=query.device)
+    rows = torch.tensor(
+        sorted(
+            {
+                0,
+                min(127, seqlen_q - 1),
+                min(128, seqlen_q - 1),
+                min(255, seqlen_q - 1),
+                min(256, seqlen_q - 1),
+                seqlen_q // 2,
+                seqlen_q - 1,
+            }
+        ),
+        device=query.device,
+    )
+    heads = torch.tensor(
+        sorted({0, num_heads // 2, num_heads - 1}), device=query.device
+    )
+
+    def sample_query(tensor):
+        return (
+            tensor.index_select(1, rows).index_select(2, heads).index_select(0, batches)
+        )
+
+    query_fp64 = sample_query(query).transpose(1, 2).double()
+    key_fp64 = (
+        key.index_select(2, heads).index_select(0, batches).transpose(1, 2).double()
+    )
+    value_fp64 = (
+        value.index_select(2, heads).index_select(0, batches).transpose(1, 2).double()
+    )
+    probabilities = torch.softmax(
+        query_fp64 @ key_fp64.transpose(-1, -2) * head_size**-0.5, dim=-1
+    )
+    reference = (probabilities @ value_fp64).transpose(1, 2)
+    reference_rms = reference.square().mean().sqrt().item()
+    metrics = {}
+    for name, output in outputs.items():
+        actual = sample_query(output).double()
+        difference = actual - reference
+        rms_error = difference.square().mean().sqrt().item()
+        relative_rms = rms_error / max(reference_rms, 1e-30)
+        tolerance = 0.003 if query.dtype == torch.bfloat16 else 0.001
+        if not torch.isfinite(actual).all() or relative_rms > tolerance:
+            raise AssertionError(
+                f"{name} failed independent FP64 check: relative RMS={relative_rms}"
+            )
+        torch.testing.assert_close(
+            actual, reference, rtol=0.01, atol=0.01 * reference_rms
+        )
+        metrics[name] = {
+            "relative_rms": relative_rms,
+            "max_abs": difference.abs().max().item(),
+        }
+    print(
+        "independent_fp64="
+        + json.dumps(
+            {
+                "batches": batches.tolist(),
+                "query_rows": rows.tolist(),
+                "heads": heads.tolist(),
+                "all_keys": key.shape[1],
+                "metrics": metrics,
+            },
+            sort_keys=True,
+        )
+    )
+
+
+def package_provenance(module):
+    source = Path(module.__file__).resolve()
+    result = {
+        "version": getattr(module, "__version__", "unknown"),
+        "source": str(source),
+    }
+    for parent in source.parents:
+        if not (parent / ".git").exists():
+            continue
+        try:
+            revision = subprocess.run(
+                ["git", "-C", str(parent), "rev-parse", "HEAD"],
+                capture_output=True,
+                text=True,
+                check=True,
+                timeout=5,
+            )
+            result["revision"] = revision.stdout.strip()
+            status = subprocess.run(
+                [
+                    "git",
+                    "-C",
+                    str(parent),
+                    "status",
+                    "--porcelain",
+                    "--untracked-files=no",
+                ],
+                capture_output=True,
+                text=True,
+                check=True,
+                timeout=5,
+            )
+            result["tracked_source_modified"] = bool(status.stdout.strip())
+        except (OSError, subprocess.SubprocessError):
+            result["revision"] = "unavailable"
+        break
+    return result
+
+
+def print_provenance(device):
+    properties = torch.cuda.get_device_properties(device)
+    provenance = {
+        "python": platform.python_version(),
+        "torch": torch.__version__,
+        "torch_revision": torch.version.git_version,
+        "hip": torch.version.hip,
+        "device": properties.name,
+        "architecture": getattr(properties, "gcnArchName", "unknown"),
+        "triton": package_provenance(triton),
+        "aiter": package_provenance(aiter),
+        "ENABLE_CK": bool(ENABLE_CK),
+        "ENABLE_CK_env": os.environ.get("ENABLE_CK", "<unset>"),
+        "aiter_baseline": "AITerImpl-equivalent, input dtype, default scale, how_v3_bf16_cvt=2",
+    }
+    print("provenance=" + json.dumps(provenance, sort_keys=True))
+
+
+def parse_args():
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
+    parser.add_argument("--preset", choices=PRESETS, default="reference")
+    parser.add_argument(
+        "--batch",
+        type=int,
+        help="Override preset batch; Wan defaults to one CFG branch.",
+    )
+    parser.add_argument("--sq", type=int)
+    parser.add_argument("--sk", type=int)
+    parser.add_argument("--heads", type=int)
+    parser.add_argument("--head-size", type=int, choices=(64, 128, 256), default=128)
+    parser.add_argument("--dtype", choices=("bf16", "fp16"), default="bf16")
+    parser.add_argument("--warmup", type=int, default=25)
+    parser.add_argument("--rep", type=int, default=100)
+    parser.add_argument("--rounds", type=int, default=5)
+    parser.add_argument(
+        "--provider", choices=("both", "aiter", "gluon"), default="both"
+    )
+    parser.add_argument("--skip-check", action="store_true")
+    parser.add_argument("--trace-provider", choices=("aiter", "gluon"))
+    parser.add_argument(
+        "--schedule",
+        choices=("auto", "pipeline", "pingpong", "persistent"),
+    )
+    parser.add_argument("--scheduler")
+    return parser.parse_args()
+
+
+def main():
+    args = parse_args()
+    batch, seqlen_q, seqlen_k, num_heads = PRESETS[args.preset]
+    batch = args.batch or batch
+    seqlen_q = args.sq or seqlen_q
+    seqlen_k = args.sk or seqlen_k
+    num_heads = args.heads or num_heads
+
+    dtype = torch.bfloat16 if args.dtype == "bf16" else torch.float16
+    torch.manual_seed(0)
+    query = torch.randn(
+        batch,
+        seqlen_q,
+        num_heads,
+        args.head_size,
+        device="cuda",
+        dtype=dtype,
+    )
+    key = torch.randn(
+        batch,
+        seqlen_k,
+        num_heads,
+        args.head_size,
+        device="cuda",
+        dtype=dtype,
+    )
+    value = torch.randn_like(key)
+
+    print_provenance(query.device)
+
+    config = select_fav3_launch_config(
+        batch,
+        num_heads,
+        seqlen_q,
+        seqlen_k=seqlen_k,
+        head_size=args.head_size,
+        dtype=dtype,
+    )
+    if args.schedule not in (None, "auto"):
+        schedule_configs = {
+            "pipeline": FAv3LaunchConfig("pipeline", 128, 64, 4, False, ""),
+            "pingpong": FAv3LaunchConfig("pingpong", 256, 64, 8, True, ""),
+            "persistent": FAv3LaunchConfig(
+                "persistent", 128, 256, 4, True, "amdgpu-sched-strategy=iterative-ilp"
+            ),
+        }
+        config = schedule_configs[args.schedule]
+    if args.scheduler is not None:
+        if config.schedule == "persistent":
+            raise ValueError(
+                "--scheduler cannot override the persistent kernel scheduler"
+            )
+        scheduler = (
+            ""
+            if args.scheduler in ("", "default")
+            else f"amdgpu-sched-strategy={args.scheduler}"
+        )
+        config = config._replace(llvm_fn_attrs=scheduler)
+
+    def gluon_attention():
+        return gluon_fav3_attention(
+            query,
+            key,
+            value,
+            launch_config=(
+                None
+                if args.schedule in (None, "auto") and args.scheduler is None
+                else config
+            ),
+        )
+
+    if args.trace_provider is not None:
+        function = (
+            (lambda: aiter_attention(query, key, value))
+            if args.trace_provider == "aiter"
+            else gluon_attention
+        )
+        function()
+        torch.cuda.synchronize()
+        function()
+        torch.cuda.synchronize()
+        print(f"traced {args.trace_provider}")
+        return
+
+    all_functions = {
+        "aiter": lambda: aiter_attention(query, key, value),
+        "gluon": gluon_attention,
+    }
+    names = ("aiter", "gluon") if args.provider == "both" else (args.provider,)
+    functions = {name: all_functions[name] for name in names}
+
+    if not args.skip_check:
+        outputs = {name: function() for name, function in functions.items()}
+        torch.cuda.synchronize()
+        for name, output in outputs.items():
+            if not torch.isfinite(output).all():
+                raise AssertionError(f"{name} produced non-finite output")
+        check_sampled_fp64(query, key, value, outputs)
+        if args.provider == "both":

+"""Dense FAv3 forward kernel specialized for AMD gfx1250.
+
+Inputs and output use SGLang diffusion's ``[batch, sequence, heads, dim]``
+layout. The production path supports non-causal BF16/FP16 MHA with head
+dimensions 64, 128, and 256. BF16/D128 retains the specialized guarded and
+persistent schedules. Unsupported contracts are handled by the diffusion backend
+before this module is imported.
+
+This is adapted from Triton's ``f16_fa_cdna5.py`` example:
+https://github.com/triton-lang/triton/blob/b63e34c521dfc55a5f9e419cfeaa64df8263891f/third_party/amd/python/examples/gluon/f16_fa_cdna5.py
+
+It carries the gfx1250 launch, scheduler, softmax-stage, and TDM-output tuning
+validated by the TokenSpeed/Triton optimization work.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import functools
+import math
+from typing import NamedTuple
+
+import torch
+import triton.experimental.gluon.language as gl
+from triton.experimental import gluon
+from triton.runtime import driver

+
+class FAv3LaunchConfig(NamedTuple):
+    schedule: str
+    block_m: int
+    block_n: int
+    num_warps: int
+    tdm_output: bool
+    llvm_fn_attrs: str
+
+
+@gluon.jit
+def _round_norm_probabilities(probabilities):
+    # Pack eight values with the same RTNE instruction used by the BF16 cast.
+    # Return both the BF16 values for PV and their exact FP32 expansion for the
+    # denominator, avoiding redundant 16-bit moves in the generic conversion.
+    # Outputs 0:4 are packed BF16 words, outputs 4:12 are FP32, inputs 12:20
+    # are FP32. Early-clobber outputs preserve inputs until all four conversions
+    # have consumed them; expanded outputs can then reuse input registers.
+    return gl.inline_asm_elementwise(
+        """
+        v_cvt_pk_bf16_f32 $0, $12, $13
+        v_cvt_pk_bf16_f32 $1, $14, $15
+        v_cvt_pk_bf16_f32 $2, $16, $17
+        v_cvt_pk_bf16_f32 $3, $18, $19
+        v_lshlrev_b32 $4, 16, $0
+        v_and_b32 $5, 0xffff0000, $0
+        v_lshlrev_b32 $6, 16, $1
+        v_and_b32 $7, 0xffff0000, $1
+        v_lshlrev_b32 $8, 16, $2
+        v_and_b32 $9, 0xffff0000, $2
+        v_lshlrev_b32 $10, 16, $3
+        v_and_b32 $11, 0xffff0000, $3
+        """,
+        constraints="=&v,=&v,=&v,=&v,=v,=v,=v,=v,=v,=v,=v,=v,v,v,v,v,v,v,v,v",
+        args=[probabilities],
+        dtype=(gl.bfloat16, gl.float32),
+        is_pure=True,
+        pack=8,
+    )
+
+
+@gluon.aggregate

+    SEQLEN_Q: gl.constexpr
+    SEQLEN_K: gl.constexpr
+    HEAD_SIZE: gl.constexpr
+    BLOCK_M: gl.constexpr
+    BLOCK_N: gl.constexpr
+    NUM_BUFFERS: gl.constexpr
+    FAST_EXP: gl.constexpr
+    NORM_EXP: gl.constexpr
+    FULL_TDM_WAIT: gl.constexpr
+    query_axis: gl.constexpr
+
+    qk_layout: gl.constexpr
+    pv_layout: gl.constexpr
+    k_smem_layout: gl.constexpr
+    v_smem_layout: gl.constexpr
+    q_layout: gl.constexpr
+    k_layout: gl.constexpr
+    v_layout: gl.constexpr
+    p_layout: gl.constexpr

+    @gluon.constexpr_function
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        seqlen_q,
+        seqlen_k,
+        head_size,
+        block_m,
+        block_n,
+        num_buffers,
+        num_warps,
+        fast_exp=False,
+        norm_exp=False,
+        full_tdm_wait=False,
+    ):
+        self.SEQLEN_Q = gl.constexpr(seqlen_q)
+        self.SEQLEN_K = gl.constexpr(seqlen_k)
+        self.HEAD_SIZE = gl.constexpr(head_size)
+        self.BLOCK_M = gl.constexpr(block_m)
+        self.BLOCK_N = gl.constexpr(block_n)
+        self.NUM_BUFFERS = gl.constexpr(num_buffers)
+        self.FAST_EXP = gl.constexpr(fast_exp)
+        self.NORM_EXP = gl.constexpr(norm_exp)
+        self.FULL_TDM_WAIT = gl.constexpr(full_tdm_wait)
+        # Keep nearby long-sequence query tiles on the same head to improve
+        # K/V cache reuse across workgroups.
+        self.query_axis = gl.constexpr(
+            0 if block_m == 256 and seqlen_k >= 16_384 else 2
+        )
+
+        assert num_warps == 4 or num_warps == 8
+        warp_bases = [[1, 0], [2, 0]]
+        if num_warps == 8:
+            warp_bases.append([4, 0])
+
+        self.qk_layout = gl.constexpr(
+            gl.amd.AMDWMMALayout(
+                3,
+                transposed=True,
+                warp_bases=warp_bases,
+                instr_shape=[16, 16, 32],
+            )
+        )
+        self.pv_layout = gl.constexpr(
+            gl.amd.AMDWMMALayout(
+                3,
+                transposed=True,
+                warp_bases=warp_bases,
+                instr_shape=[16, 16, 32],
+            )
+        )
+        self.k_smem_layout = gl.constexpr(
+            gl.PaddedSharedLayout.with_identity_for(
+                [[head_size, 8]], [block_n, head_size], [1, 0]
+            )
+        )
+        self.v_smem_layout = gl.constexpr(
+            gl.PaddedSharedLayout.with_identity_for(
+                [[head_size, 16]], [block_n, head_size], [1, 0]
+            )
+        )
+        self.q_layout = gl.constexpr(gl.DotOperandLayout(0, self.qk_layout, 8))
+        self.k_layout = gl.constexpr(gl.DotOperandLayout(1, self.qk_layout, 8))
+        self.v_layout = gl.constexpr(gl.DotOperandLayout(1, self.pv_layout, 8))
+        self.p_layout = gl.constexpr(gl.DotOperandLayout(0, self.pv_layout, 8))
+
+
+@gluon.aggregate
+class _AttentionProgram:
+    cfg: _AttentionConfig
+    q: gl.tensor
+    k_desc: gl.amd.cdna5.tdm.tensor_descriptor
+    k_buffer: gl.shared_memory_descriptor
+    v_desc: gl.amd.cdna5.tdm.tensor_descriptor
+    v_buffer: gl.shared_memory_descriptor
+    output_ptr: gl.tensor
+    output_offsets: gl.tensor
+    output_mask: gl.tensor
+    output_uses_buffer: gl.constexpr
+    softmax_scale_log2: gl.constexpr
+
+    @gluon.constexpr_function
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        cfg,
+        q,
+        k_desc,
+        k_buffer,
+        v_desc,
+        v_buffer,
+        output_ptr,
+        output_offsets,
+        output_mask,
+        softmax_scale,
+        output_uses_buffer,
+    ):
+        self.cfg = cfg
+        self.q = q
+        self.k_desc = k_desc
+        self.k_buffer = k_buffer
+        self.v_desc = v_desc
+        self.v_buffer = v_buffer
+        self.output_ptr = output_ptr
+        self.output_offsets = output_offsets
+        self.output_mask = output_mask
+        self.output_uses_buffer = gl.constexpr(output_uses_buffer)
+        self.softmax_scale_log2 = gl.constexpr(softmax_scale * 1.4426950408889634)
+
+    @gluon.jit
+    def create(
+        cfg,
+        q_ptr,
+        k_ptr,
+        v_ptr,
+        output_ptr,
+        stride_qb,
+        stride_qh,
+        stride_qs,
+        stride_qd,
+        stride_kb,
+        stride_kh,
+        stride_ks,
+        stride_kd,
+        stride_vb,
+        stride_vh,
+        stride_vs,
+        stride_vd,
+        stride_ob,
+        stride_oh,
+        stride_os,
+        stride_od,
+        softmax_scale: gl.constexpr,
+        use_query_buffer: gl.constexpr,
+        use_output_buffer: gl.constexpr,
+    ):
+        batch_id = gl.program_id(2 - cfg.query_axis)
+        head_id = gl.program_id(1)
+        query_start = gl.program_id(cfg.query_axis) * cfg.BLOCK_M
+        batch_id_i64 = batch_id.to(gl.int64)
+        head_id_i64 = head_id.to(gl.int64)
+
+        query_local_rows = gl.arange(
+            0, cfg.BLOCK_M, layout=gl.SliceLayout(1, cfg.q_layout)
+        )
+        query_rows = query_start + query_local_rows
+        query_dims = gl.arange(0, cfg.HEAD_SIZE, layout=gl.SliceLayout(0, cfg.q_layout))
+        query_mask = query_rows[:, None] < cfg.SEQLEN_Q
+        # Buffer offsets are 32-bit. Put the sequence tile offset in the
+        # 64-bit base so long videos do not wrap at the buffer-address limit.
+        query_base = (
+            q_ptr
+            + stride_qb * batch_id_i64
+            + stride_qh * head_id_i64
+            + stride_qs * query_start.to(gl.int64)
+        )
+        if use_query_buffer:
+            query_offsets = (
+                stride_qs * query_local_rows[:, None] + stride_qd * query_dims[None, :]
+            )
+            q = gl.amd.cdna5.buffer_load(
+                query_base, query_offsets, mask=query_mask, other=0.0
+            )
+        else:
+            # A sparse view can span the buffer range inside one query tile.
+            query_offsets = stride_qs * query_local_rows[:, None].to(
+                gl.int64
+            ) + stride_qd * query_dims[None, :].to(gl.int64)
+            q = gl.load(query_base + query_offsets, mask=query_mask, other=0.0)
+
+        k_desc = gl.amd.cdna5.tdm.make_tensor_descriptor(
+            base=k_ptr + stride_kb * batch_id_i64 + stride_kh * head_id_i64,
+            shape=(cfg.SEQLEN_K, cfg.HEAD_SIZE),
+            strides=(stride_ks, stride_kd),
+            block_shape=(cfg.BLOCK_N, cfg.HEAD_SIZE),
+            layout=cfg.k_smem_layout,
+        )
+        k_buffer = gl.allocate_shared_memory(
+            k_desc.dtype,
+            shape=[cfg.NUM_BUFFERS] + k_desc.block_shape,
+            layout=k_desc.layout,
+        )
+        v_desc = gl.amd.cdna5.tdm.make_tensor_descriptor(
+            base=v_ptr + stride_vb * batch_id_i64 + stride_vh * head_id_i64,
+            shape=(cfg.SEQLEN_K, cfg.HEAD_SIZE),
+            strides=(stride_vs, stride_vd),
+            block_shape=(cfg.BLOCK_N, cfg.HEAD_SIZE),
+            layout=cfg.v_smem_layout,
+        )
+        v_buffer = gl.allocate_shared_memory(
+            v_desc.dtype,
+            shape=[cfg.NUM_BUFFERS] + v_desc.block_shape,
+            layout=v_desc.layout,
+        )
+
+        output_local_rows = gl.arange(
+            0, cfg.BLOCK_M, layout=gl.SliceLayout(1, cfg.pv_layout)
+        )
+        output_rows = query_start + output_local_rows
+        output_dims = gl.arange(
+            0, cfg.HEAD_SIZE, layout=gl.SliceLayout(0, cfg.pv_layout)
+        )
+        if use_output_buffer:
+            output_offsets = (
+                stride_os * output_local_rows[:, None]
+                + stride_od * output_dims[None, :]
+            )
+        else:
+            output_offsets = stride_os * output_local_rows[:, None].to(
+                gl.int64
+            ) + stride_od * output_dims[None, :].to(gl.int64)
+        output_mask = output_rows[:, None] < cfg.SEQLEN_Q
+        output_base = (
+            output_ptr
+            + stride_ob * batch_id_i64
+            + stride_oh * head_id_i64
+            + stride_os * query_start.to(gl.int64)
+        )

+        return _AttentionProgram(
+            cfg,
+            q,
+            k_desc,
+            k_buffer,
+            v_desc,
+            v_buffer,
+            output_base,
+            output_offsets,
+            output_mask,
+            softmax_scale,
+            use_output_buffer,

+    @gluon.jit
+    def load_k(self, buffer_index, wait_count):
+        gl.amd.cdna5.tdm.async_wait(0 if self.cfg.FULL_TDM_WAIT else wait_count)
+        return (
+            self.k_buffer.index(buffer_index)
+            .permute([1, 0])
+            .load(layout=self.cfg.k_layout)
+        )

+    @gluon.jit
+    def load_v(self, buffer_index, wait_count):
+        gl.amd.cdna5.tdm.async_wait(0 if self.cfg.FULL_TDM_WAIT else wait_count)
+        return self.v_buffer.index(buffer_index).load(layout=self.cfg.v_layout)

+    @gluon.jit
+    def prefetch_k(self, sequence_start, buffer_index):
+        gl.amd.cdna5.tdm.async_load(

+            self.k_buffer.index(buffer_index),
+            warp_used_hint=0x0F,
+            cache_modifier=".cg",
+        )

+        gl.amd.cdna5.tdm.async_load(
+            self.v_desc,
+            [sequence_start, 0],
+            self.v_buffer.index(buffer_index),
+            warp_used_hint=0x0F,
+            cache_modifier=".cg",
+        )

+    @gluon.jit

+        scores = gl.zeros(
+            [self.cfg.BLOCK_M, self.cfg.BLOCK_N],

+            0, self.cfg.BLOCK_N, layout=gl.SliceLayout(0, self.cfg.qk_layout)

+

+    def qk_full(self, k):
+        scores = gl.zeros(
+            [self.cfg.BLOCK_M, self.cfg.BLOCK_N],
+            dtype=gl.float32,
+            layout=self.cfg.qk_layout,
+        )
+        return gl.amd.cdna5.wmma(self.q, k, scores)

+    @gluon.jit
+    def softmax_part0(self, scores, row_max):

+def _attention_forward_norm_selected(
+    q_ptr,
+    k_ptr,
+    v_ptr,
+    output_ptr,
+    invalid_ptr,
+    stride_qb: gl.constexpr,
+    stride_qh: gl.constexpr,
+    stride_qs: gl.constexpr,
+    stride_qd: gl.constexpr,
+    stride_kb: gl.constexpr,
+    stride_kh: gl.constexpr,
+    stride_ks: gl.constexpr,
+    stride_kd: gl.constexpr,
+    stride_vb: gl.constexpr,
+    stride_vh: gl.constexpr,
+    stride_vs: gl.constexpr,
+    stride_vd: gl.constexpr,
+    stride_ob: gl.constexpr,
+    stride_oh: gl.constexpr,
+    stride_os: gl.constexpr,
+    stride_od: gl.constexpr,
+    SOFTMAX_SCALE: gl.constexpr,
+    SEQLEN_Q: gl.constexpr,
+    SEQLEN_K: gl.constexpr,
+    BLOCK_M: gl.constexpr,
+    BLOCK_N: gl.constexpr,
+    HEAD_SIZE: gl.constexpr,

+    USE_QUERY_BUFFER: gl.constexpr = True,
+    USE_OUTPUT_BUFFER: gl.constexpr = True,
+):

+    forward_args = (
+        q_ptr,
+        k_ptr,
+        v_ptr,
+        output_ptr,
+        stride_qb,
+        stride_qh,
+        stride_qs,
+        stride_qd,
+        stride_kb,
+        stride_kh,
+        stride_ks,
+        stride_kd,
+        stride_vb,
+        stride_vh,
+        stride_vs,
+        stride_vd,
+        stride_ob,
+        stride_oh,
+        stride_os,
+        stride_od,
+    )
+    # Route 3 combines the norm-bounded and element-bounded algorithms.
+    # Keep the raw algorithm separate to preserve its register allocation.
+    if ROUTE == 3:
+        if (bits & 1) == 0:
+            _attention_forward_pingpong(
+                *forward_args,
+                SOFTMAX_SCALE,
+                SEQLEN_Q,
+                SEQLEN_K,
+                BLOCK_M,
+                BLOCK_N,
+                HEAD_SIZE,
+                TDM_OUTPUT,
+                USE_QUERY_BUFFER,
+                USE_OUTPUT_BUFFER,
+                FAST_EXP=False,
+                NORM_EXP=True,
+            )
+        elif bits == 1:
+            _attention_forward_pingpong(
+                *forward_args,
+                SOFTMAX_SCALE,
+                SEQLEN_Q,
+                SEQLEN_K,
+                BLOCK_M,
+                BLOCK_N,
+                HEAD_SIZE,
+                TDM_OUTPUT,
+                USE_QUERY_BUFFER,
+                USE_OUTPUT_BUFFER,
+                FAST_EXP=True,
+                NORM_EXP=False,
+            )
+    else:
+        selected = (
+            ((ROUTE == 0) & ((bits & 1) == 0))
+            | ((ROUTE == 1) & (bits == 1))
+            | ((ROUTE == 2) & (bits == 3))
+        )
+        if selected:
+            _attention_forward_pingpong(
+                *forward_args,
+                SOFTMAX_SCALE,
+                SEQLEN_Q,
+                SEQLEN_K,
+                BLOCK_M,
+                BLOCK_N,
+                HEAD_SIZE,
+                TDM_OUTPUT,
+                USE_QUERY_BUFFER,
+                USE_OUTPUT_BUFFER,
+                FAST_EXP=ROUTE == 1,
+                NORM_EXP=ROUTE == 0,
+            )

+@gluon.jit
+def _range_atomic(
+    q,
+    k,
+    invalid_ptr,
+    NQ: gl.constexpr,
+    NK: gl.constexpr,
+    SQ: gl.constexpr,
+    SK: gl.constexpr,
+    H: gl.constexpr,
+    QB: gl.constexpr,
+    QS: gl.constexpr,
+    QH: gl.constexpr,
+    QD: gl.constexpr,
+    KB: gl.constexpr,
+    KS: gl.constexpr,
+    KH: gl.constexpr,
+    KD: gl.constexpr,
+    BOUND: gl.constexpr,
+    CONTIGUOUS: gl.constexpr,
+    BLOCK: gl.constexpr,
+):
+    pid = gl.program_id(0)
+    q_blocks: gl.constexpr = gl.cdiv(NQ, BLOCK)
+    offsets = gl.arange(0, BLOCK, layout=gl.BlockedLayout([1], [32], [4], [0]))
+    if pid < q_blocks:
+        index = pid.to(gl.int64) * BLOCK + offsets
+        if CONTIGUOUS:
+            ptr = q + index
+        else:
+            batch = index // (SQ * H * 128)
+            seq = (index // (H * 128)) % SQ
+            head = (index // 128) % H
+            dim = index % 128
+            ptr = q + batch * QB + seq * QS + head * QH + dim * QD
+        values = gl.load(ptr, mask=index < NQ, other=0).to(gl.float32)
+    else:
+        index = (pid - q_blocks).to(gl.int64) * BLOCK + offsets
+        if CONTIGUOUS:
+            ptr = k + index
+        else:
+            batch = index // (SK * H * 128)
+            seq = (index // (H * 128)) % SK
+            head = (index // 128) % H
+            dim = index % 128
+            ptr = k + batch * KB + seq * KS + head * KH + dim * KD
+        values = gl.load(ptr, mask=index < NK, other=0).to(gl.float32)
+    invalid = gl.max((~(gl.abs(values) <= BOUND)).to(gl.int32), 0)
+    if invalid != 0:
+        gl.atomic_or(invalid_ptr, invalid, sem="relaxed")
+

+@gluon.jit
+def _clear_invalid(invalid):
+    gl.store(invalid, 0)
+
+
+def _guard_bound(scale):
+    # Bound D*max(|Q|)*max(|K|)*scale_log2. Reserve FP32 accumulation margin.
+    # At magnitude <=1024, rounding the scaled maximum introduces at most
+    # 2**-14 of exponent error, keeping its fused exponent near zero.
+    return math.sqrt(1024 / (128 * scale * 1.4426950408889634)) * (1 - 1e-5)
+
+
+def _check_bounded_inputs(query, key, invalid, softmax_scale):
+    block = 8192
+    count = math.ceil(query.numel() / block) + math.ceil(key.numel() / block)
+    _clear_invalid[(1,)](invalid, num_warps=4)
+    _range_atomic[(count,)](
+        query,
+        key,
+        invalid,
+        query.numel(),
+        key.numel(),
+        query.shape[1],
+        key.shape[1],
+        query.shape[2],
+        *query.stride(),
+        *key.stride(),
+        _guard_bound(softmax_scale),
+        query.is_contiguous() and key.is_contiguous(),
+        block,
+        num_warps=4,
+    )
+
+
+def _launch_guarded_attention(query, key, value, output, invalid, softmax_scale):
+    # These ordered kernels are captured together. Every replay clears and
+    # recomputes the flag, so mutated inputs cannot reuse an earlier decision.
+    _check_bounded_inputs(query, key, invalid, softmax_scale)
+    batch, seqlen_q, num_heads, _ = query.shape
+    seqlen_k = key.shape[1]
+    query_tiles = math.ceil(seqlen_q / 256)
+    grid = (
+        (query_tiles, num_heads, batch)
+        if seqlen_k >= 16384
+        else (batch, num_heads, query_tiles)
+    )
+    strides = tuple(
+        s
+        for tensor in (query, key, value, output)
+        for s in (
+            tensor.stride(0),
+            tensor.stride(2),
+            tensor.stride(1),
+            tensor.stride(3),
+        )
+    )
+    query_tile_bytes = (
+        255 * query.stride(1) + 127 * query.stride(3) + 1
+    ) * query.element_size()
+    output_tile_bytes = (
+        255 * output.stride(1) + 127 * output.stride(3) + 1
+    ) * output.element_size()
+    for fast in (True, False):
+        _attention_forward_selected[grid](
+            query,
+            key,
+            value,
+            output,
+            invalid,
+            *strides,
+            softmax_scale,
+            seqlen_q,
+            seqlen_k,
+            256,
+            64,
+            128,
+            fast,
+            TDM_OUTPUT=True,
+            USE_QUERY_BUFFER=query_tile_bytes <= 2**31,
+            USE_OUTPUT_BUFFER=output_tile_bytes <= 2**31,
+            num_warps=8,
+            waves_per_eu=2,
+            llvm_fn_attrs="amdgpu-sched-strategy=max-ilp",
+            enable_fp_fusion=True,
+        )

+def _norm_guard_bound(scale):
+    # Cauchy-Schwarz bounds |QK| by the product of the row norms. The 1e-4
+    # margin covers FP32 norm reduction and dot-product accumulation rounding;
+    # the fixed shift then keeps exp2 arguments in [-64, 0].
+    return (32.0 / (scale * 1.4426950408889634)) * (1.0 - 1e-4)

+@gluon.jit
+def _norm_range_atomic(
+    x_ptr,
+    invalid_ptr,
+    B: gl.constexpr,
+    S: gl.constexpr,
+    H: gl.constexpr,
+    SB: gl.constexpr,
+    SS: gl.constexpr,
+    SH: gl.constexpr,
+    SD: gl.constexpr,
+    BOUND: gl.constexpr,
+    FMA_BOUND: gl.constexpr,
+    CONTIGUOUS: gl.constexpr,
+):
+    layout: gl.constexpr = gl.BlockedLayout([1, 4], [1, 32], [4, 1], [1, 0])
+    rows = gl.program_id(0).to(gl.int64) * 16 + gl.arange(
+        0, 16, layout=gl.SliceLayout(1, layout)
+    ).to(gl.int64)
+    dims = gl.arange(0, 128, layout=gl.SliceLayout(0, layout)).to(gl.int64)
+    if CONTIGUOUS:
+        offsets = rows[:, None] * 128 + dims[None, :]
+    else:
+        batch = rows // (S * H)
+        seq = (rows // H) % S
+        head = rows % H
+        offsets = (
+            batch[:, None] * SB
+            + seq[:, None] * SS
+            + head[:, None] * SH
+            + dims[None, :] * SD
+        )
+    x = gl.load(x_ptr + offsets, mask=rows[:, None] < B * S * H, other=0.0).to(
+        gl.float32
+    )
+    norm = gl.sum(x * x, 1)
+    invalid_norm = gl.sum(((norm > BOUND) | (norm != norm)).to(gl.int32), 0) != 0
+    invalid_fma = (
+        gl.sum(gl.sum(((gl.abs(x) > FMA_BOUND) | (x != x)).to(gl.int32), 1), 0) != 0
+    )
+    bits = invalid_norm.to(gl.int32) | (invalid_fma.to(gl.int32) << 1)
+    if bits != 0:
+        gl.atomic_or(invalid_ptr, bits, sem="relaxed")
+

+@gluon.jit
+def _value_range_atomic(
+    x_ptr,
+    invalid_ptr,
+    B: gl.constexpr,
+    S: gl.constexpr,
+    H: gl.constexpr,
+    SB: gl.constexpr,
+    SS: gl.constexpr,
+    SH: gl.constexpr,
+    SD: gl.constexpr,
+    CONTIGUOUS: gl.constexpr,
+    BLOCK: gl.constexpr,
+):
+    i = gl.program_id(0).to(gl.int64) * BLOCK + gl.arange(
+        0, BLOCK, layout=gl.BlockedLayout([1], [32], [4], [0])
+    ).to(gl.int64)
+    if CONTIGUOUS:
+        offsets = i
+    else:
+        rows = i // 128
+        offsets = (
+            (rows // (S * H)) * SB
+            + ((rows // H) % S) * SS
+            + (rows % H) * SH
+            + (i % 128) * SD
+        )
+    x = gl.abs(
+        gl.load(x_ptr + offsets, mask=i < B * S * H * 128, other=0.0).to(gl.float32)
+    )
+    # With P in [2^-64, 1], this range keeps nonzero P*V products normal
+    # in FP32 and sums finite for the guarded sequence-length limit.
+    invalid = (
+        (x != x)
+        | (x > 18446744073709551616.0)
+        | ((x != 0.0) & (x < 2.3283064365386963e-10))
+    )
+    if gl.sum(invalid.to(gl.int32), 0) != 0:
+        gl.atomic_or(invalid_ptr, 1, sem="relaxed")
+

+def _check_norm_bounded_inputs(q, k, v, invalid, scale):
+    _clear_invalid[(1,)](invalid, num_warps=4)
+    for x in (q, k):

+            s,

+            _guard_bound(scale),
+            x.is_contiguous(),
+            num_warps=4,

+    b, s, h, d = v.shape
+    _value_range_atomic[(math.ceil(v.numel() / 8192),)](
+        v, invalid, b, s, h, *v.stride(), v.is_contiguous(), 8192, num_warps=4
+    )

+@functools.lru_cache(maxsize=None)
+def _get_num_cus(device_index: int) -> int:
+    properties = driver.active.utils.get_device_properties(device_index)
+    return int(properties["multiprocessor_count"])

+def get_num_cus(device: torch.device | int | None = None) -> int:
+    """Return the CU count for a specific device, cached per device index."""
+    if device is None:
+        device_index = driver.active.get_device_interface().current_device()
+    elif isinstance(device, torch.device):
+        device_index = device.index
+        if device_index is None:
+            device_index = driver.active.get_device_interface().current_device()
+    else:
+        device_index = int(device)
+    return _get_num_cus(device_index)

+def _get_persistent_query_groups(
+    batch: int, num_heads: int, seqlen_q: int, num_cus: int
+) -> int:
+    """Balance persistent query work without underfilling the device."""
+    if num_cus <= 0:
+        raise ValueError("num_cus must be positive")
+    query_blocks = math.ceil(seqlen_q / 128)
+    query_groups = math.ceil(query_blocks / 29)
+    batch_heads = batch * num_heads
+
+    # Align the grid to a whole multiple of the CU count, while retaining
+    # at least two workgroups per CU. Small grids keep the existing grouping.
+    group_multiple = num_cus // math.gcd(batch_heads, num_cus)
+    aligned_groups = query_groups // group_multiple * group_multiple
+    if aligned_groups * batch_heads < 2 * num_cus:
+        return query_groups
+
+    # Compare the estimated query tiles on the most heavily loaded CU.
+    # Fewer groups reuse K/V longer, but must not increase the longest workload.
+    original_tiles = math.ceil(query_groups * batch_heads / num_cus) * math.ceil(
+        query_blocks / query_groups
+    )
+    aligned_tiles = (aligned_groups * batch_heads // num_cus) * math.ceil(
+        query_blocks / aligned_groups
+    )
+    return aligned_groups if aligned_tiles < original_tiles else query_groups
+

+def select_fav3_launch_config(
+    batch: int,
+    num_heads: int,
+    seqlen_q: int,
+    *,
+    seqlen_k: int | None = None,
+    num_cus: int | None = None,
+    head_size: int = 128,
+    dtype: torch.dtype = torch.bfloat16,
+) -> FAv3LaunchConfig:
+    """Select a gfx1250 launch while retaining the BF16/D128 specializations."""
+    if head_size not in (64, 128, 256):
+        raise ValueError(
+            f"Gluon FAv3 requires head_size in (64, 128, 256), got {head_size}"
+        )
+    if dtype not in (torch.bfloat16, torch.float16):
+        raise TypeError("Gluon FAv3 requires BF16 or FP16")
+    if min(batch, num_heads, seqlen_q) <= 0:
+        raise ValueError("batch, num_heads, and seqlen_q must be positive")
+    if num_cus is None:
+        num_cus = get_num_cus()
+
+    persistent_groups = _get_persistent_query_groups(
+        batch, num_heads, seqlen_q, num_cus
+    )
+    persistent_workgroups = batch * num_heads * persistent_groups
+    if (
+        head_size == 128
+        and dtype == torch.bfloat16
+        and seqlen_k is not None
+        and 257 <= seqlen_k <= 512
+        and persistent_workgroups >= num_cus
+    ):
+        return FAv3LaunchConfig(
+            "persistent",
+            128,
+            256,
+            4,
+            True,
+            "amdgpu-sched-strategy=iterative-ilp",
+        )
+
+    wide_block_m = 256
+    workgroups = batch * num_heads * math.ceil(seqlen_q / wide_block_m)
+    # D256 spills heavily with the wide eight-wave tile. The four-wave
+    # pipeline keeps its larger output accumulator in registers.
+    if head_size != 256 and workgroups >= num_cus:
+        # TDM output is profitable at and above the same full-device boundary
+        # that admits the wide ping-pong tile.
+        scheduler = (
+            "amdgpu-sched-strategy=max-ilp"
+            if seqlen_k is not None and (seqlen_k <= 512 or seqlen_k >= 16_384)
+            else ""
+        )
+        return FAv3LaunchConfig("pingpong", 256, 64, 8, head_size == 128, scheduler)
+    # max-ilp intermittently corrupts FP16 inputs with nonzero storage offsets.
+    # Use default pipeline scheduling until the affected cases are understood.
+    return FAv3LaunchConfig(
+        "pipeline",
+        128,
+        64,
+        4,
+        False,
+        "" if dtype == torch.float16 else "amdgpu-sched-strategy=max-ilp",
+    )
+

+def gluon_fav3_attention(
+    query: torch.Tensor,
+    key: torch.Tensor,
+    value: torch.Tensor,
+    *,
+    softmax_scale: float | None = None,
+    launch_config: FAv3LaunchConfig | None = None,
+) -> torch.Tensor:
+    """Run non-causal BF16/FP16 MHA on gfx1250.
+
+    Q/K/V use BSHD layout. Query and key sequence lengths may differ.
+    """
+    if query.ndim != 4 or key.ndim != 4 or value.ndim != 4:
+        raise ValueError("Gluon FAv3 expects rank-4 BSHD query, key, and value")
+    if (
+        query.dtype not in (torch.bfloat16, torch.float16)
+        or key.dtype != query.dtype
+        or value.dtype != query.dtype
+    ):
+        raise TypeError(
+            "Gluon FAv3 requires matching BF16 or FP16 query, key, and value"
+        )
+    if not query.is_cuda or key.device != query.device or value.device != query.device:
+        raise ValueError("Gluon FAv3 requires Q/K/V on the same ROCm device")
+
+    batch, seqlen_q, num_heads, head_size = query.shape
+    key_batch, seqlen_k, num_kv_heads, key_head_size = key.shape
+    if value.shape != key.shape:
+        raise ValueError("Gluon FAv3 requires key and value to have the same shape")
+    if (key_batch, num_kv_heads, key_head_size) != (
+        batch,
+        num_heads,
+        head_size,
+    ):
+        raise ValueError("Gluon FAv3 requires full MHA with matching Q/K/V heads")
+    if head_size not in (64, 128, 256):
+        raise ValueError(
+            f"Gluon FAv3 requires head_size in (64, 128, 256), got {head_size}"
+        )
+    if min(batch, num_heads, seqlen_q, seqlen_k) <= 0:
+        raise ValueError("Gluon FAv3 requires non-empty batches, heads, and sequences")
+    if query.stride(-1) != 1 or key.stride(-1) != 1 or value.stride(-1) != 1:
+        raise ValueError("Gluon FAv3 requires contiguous head dimensions")
+
+    if softmax_scale is None:
+        softmax_scale = head_size**-0.5
+    softmax_scale = float(softmax_scale)
+    if not math.isfinite(softmax_scale) or softmax_scale <= 0.0:
+        raise ValueError("softmax_scale must be finite and positive")
+
+    arch = getattr(torch.cuda.get_device_properties(query.device), "gcnArchName", "")
+    if "gfx1250" not in arch:
+        raise RuntimeError(
+            f"Gluon FAv3 requires gfx1250, found {arch or 'unknown GPU'}"
+        )
+
+    config = launch_config or select_fav3_launch_config(
+        batch,
+        num_heads,
+        seqlen_q,
+        seqlen_k=seqlen_k,
+        num_cus=get_num_cus(query.device),
+        head_size=head_size,
+        dtype=query.dtype,
+    )
+    if config.schedule == "persistent":
+        if query.dtype != torch.bfloat16 or head_size != 128:
+            raise ValueError("persistent requires BF16 with head_size=128")
+        expected_geometry = (128, 256, 4)
+        actual_geometry = (config.block_m, config.block_n, config.num_warps)
+        if actual_geometry != expected_geometry:
+            raise ValueError(
+                "persistent requires (block_m, block_n, num_warps)="
+                f"{expected_geometry}, got {actual_geometry}"
+            )
+        if not config.tdm_output:
+            raise ValueError("persistent requires TDM output and stable softmax")
+        if query.is_contiguous() and key.is_contiguous() and value.is_contiguous():
+            from sglang.kernels.ops.attention.gluon_fav3_persistent_gfx1250 import (
+                gluon_fav3_persistent_attention,
+            )
+
+            return gluon_fav3_persistent_attention(
+                query,
+                key,
+                value,
+                softmax_scale=softmax_scale,
+            )
+        config = FAv3LaunchConfig(
+            "pingpong",
+            256,
+            64,
+            8,
+            True,
+            "amdgpu-sched-strategy=max-ilp",
+        )
+    if config.schedule not in ("pipeline", "pingpong"):
+        raise ValueError(f"unsupported FAv3 schedule: {config.schedule}")
+    expected_geometry = (128, 64, 4) if config.schedule == "pipeline" else (256, 64, 8)
+    actual_geometry = (config.block_m, config.block_n, config.num_warps)
+    if actual_geometry != expected_geometry:
+        raise ValueError(
+            f"{config.schedule} requires (block_m, block_n, num_warps)="
+            f"{expected_geometry}, got {actual_geometry}"
+        )
+    kernel = (

+        strides=(KV_ROW_STRIDE, 1),

+        clamp_bounds=True,
+    )

+        add_offsets=[0, 0],
+        pred=True,
+        clamp_bounds=True,
+    )
+    value_desc1 = gl.amd.cdna5.tdm.update_tensor_descriptor(

+        add_offsets=[BLOCK_N, 0],
+        pred=True,
+        clamp_bounds=True,

+        [
+            (key_desc0, key_shared.index(0), 0x1),
+            (key_desc1, key_shared.index(1), 0x2),

+                    [future_query_start, 0],
+                    pred=future_query_start < SEQLEN_Q,
+                    speculative=False,

+                0,
+                BLOCK_M,
+                layout=gl.SliceLayout(1, cfg.q_layout),
+            )

+            query_dims = gl.arange(
+                0,
+                HEAD_SIZE,
+                layout=gl.SliceLayout(0, cfg.q_layout),
+            )
+            query_offsets = QUERY_ROW_STRIDE * query_local_rows[:, None].to(
+                gl.int64
+            ) + query_dims[None, :].to(gl.int64)

+                    query_tile_base,
+                    query_offsets.to(gl.int32),

+                query,

+                value_tiles,

+                output_shared,

+    value_shared._keep_alive()

+    query: torch.Tensor,

+    value: torch.Tensor,

+    softmax_scale: float | None = None,

+    """Run persistent short-KV BF16/D128 MHA on gfx1250."""
+    if query.ndim != 4 or key.ndim != 4 or value.ndim != 4:
+        raise ValueError("persistent FAv3 expects rank-4 BSHD query, key, and value")
+    batch, seqlen_q, num_heads, head_size = query.shape
+    key_batch, seqlen_k, num_kv_heads, key_head_size = key.shape
+    if value.shape != key.shape:
+        raise ValueError("persistent FAv3 requires equal key/value shapes")
+    if (key_batch, num_kv_heads, key_head_size) != (
+        batch,
+        num_heads,
+        head_size,
+    ):
+        raise ValueError("persistent FAv3 requires full MHA with matching Q/K/V")
+    if head_size != 128:
+        raise ValueError(f"persistent FAv3 requires head_size=128, got {head_size}")
+    if min(batch, num_heads, seqlen_q) <= 0:
+        raise ValueError(
+            "persistent FAv3 requires non-empty batches, heads, and query sequences"
+        )
+    if not 257 <= seqlen_k <= 512:
+        raise ValueError("persistent FAv3 requires 257 <= seqlen_k <= 512")
+    if (
+        query.dtype != torch.bfloat16
+        or key.dtype != torch.bfloat16
+        or value.dtype != torch.bfloat16
+    ):
+        raise TypeError("persistent FAv3 requires BF16 query, key, and value")
+    if not query.is_cuda or key.device != query.device or value.device != query.device:
+        raise ValueError("persistent FAv3 requires Q/K/V on the same ROCm device")
+    if (
+        not query.is_contiguous()
+        or not key.is_contiguous()
+        or not value.is_contiguous()
+    ):
+        raise ValueError(
+            "persistent FAv3 requires contiguous BSHD query, key, and value"
+        )
+    if 128 * num_heads * head_size * query.element_size() >= 2**31:
+        raise ValueError(
+            "persistent FAv3 local query-tile span exceeds the buffer range"
+        )
+
+    if softmax_scale is None:
+        softmax_scale = head_size**-0.5
+    softmax_scale = float(softmax_scale)
+    if not math.isfinite(softmax_scale) or softmax_scale <= 0.0:
+        raise ValueError("softmax_scale must be finite and positive")

+            f"persistent FAv3 requires gfx1250, found {arch or 'unknown GPU'}"
+        )

+    query_groups = _get_persistent_query_groups(
+        batch, num_heads, seqlen_q, get_num_cus(query.device)
+    )
+    base_blocks, extra_groups = divmod(query_blocks, query_groups)
+    query_tiles_per_wg = base_blocks + (extra_groups > 0)
+    output = torch.empty_like(query, memory_format=torch.contiguous_format)
+    with torch.cuda.device(query.device):

+            query,
+            key,
+            value,
+            output,
+            softmax_scale,
+            seqlen_q,
+            seqlen_k,
+            num_heads,
+            query_tiles_per_wg,
+            query_groups,
+            base_blocks,
+            extra_groups,
+            num_warps=4,
+            waves_per_eu=1,
+            llvm_fn_attrs="amdgpu-sched-strategy=iterative-ilp",
+            enable_fp_fusion=True,
+        )
+    return output

+            return "causal attention"
+        if self.dropout_p != 0.0:
+            return "nonzero dropout"
+        if self.head_size not in (64, 128, 256):
+            return f"head_size={self.head_size}"
+        if self.num_kv_heads != self.num_heads:
+            return (
+                f"grouped-query attention ({self.num_heads} Q heads, "
+                f"{self.num_kv_heads} KV heads)"
+            )
+        if query.ndim != 4 or key.ndim != 4 or value.ndim != 4:
+            return "non-BSHD tensors"
+        if query.dtype not in (torch.bfloat16, torch.float16):
+            return f"dtype={query.dtype}"
+        if key.dtype != query.dtype or value.dtype != query.dtype:
+            return "mismatched Q/K/V dtypes"
+        if (
+            not query.is_cuda
+            or key.device != query.device
+            or value.device != query.device
+        ):

+        if query.shape[0] != key.shape[0] or key.shape != value.shape:
+            return "incompatible Q/K/V batch or KV shapes"
+        if query.shape[3] != self.head_size:
+            return f"query shape={tuple(query.shape)}"
+        if key.shape[3] != self.head_size:

+                f"{key.shape[2]} KV heads)"
+            )

+            return "empty sequence"
+        if query.stride(-1) != 1 or key.stride(-1) != 1 or value.stride(-1) != 1:
+            return "non-contiguous head dimension"

+            torch.cuda.get_device_properties(query.device), "gcnArchName", ""

+

+        key: torch.Tensor,
+        value: torch.Tensor,

+                softmax_scale=self.softmax_scale,
+                causal=self.causal,
+                dropout_p=self.dropout_p,
+            )

+        key: torch.Tensor,
+        value: torch.Tensor,

+            )

+            key,
+            value,
+            softmax_scale=self.softmax_scale,

+    import triton

+    from triton.experimental.gluon import language as gl

+    from sglang.kernels.ops.attention.gluon_fav3_gfx1250 import (

+
+    @gluon.jit
+    def convert(
+        values,
+        probabilities,
+        rounded,
+        count: gl.constexpr,
+        BLOCK_M: gl.constexpr,
+        NUM_WARPS: gl.constexpr,
+    ):
+        warp_bases: gl.constexpr = (
+            [[1, 0], [2, 0]] if NUM_WARPS == 4 else [[1, 0], [2, 0], [4, 0]]
+        )
+        layout: gl.constexpr = gl.amd.AMDWMMALayout(
+            3, transposed=True, warp_bases=warp_bases, instr_shape=[16, 16, 32]
+        )
+        rows = gl.arange(0, BLOCK_M, layout=gl.SliceLayout(1, layout))
+        cols = gl.arange(0, 64, layout=gl.SliceLayout(0, layout))
+        offsets = gl.program_id(0) * (BLOCK_M * 64) + rows[:, None] * 64 + cols[None, :]
+        values = gl.load(values + offsets, offsets < count, other=0.0)
+        p, r = _round_norm_probabilities(values)
+        gl.store(probabilities + offsets, p, offsets < count)
+        gl.store(rounded + offsets, r, offsets < count)
+
+    # Cover every BF16 bin in the fixed-shift probability interval, with FP32
+    # values immediately below, at and above RTNE ties, plus exact values and zero.
+    exponents = torch.arange(63, 128, dtype=torch.int32)[:, None, None]
+    mantissas = torch.arange(128, dtype=torch.int32)[None, :, None]
+    tails = torch.tensor([0, 0x7FFF, 0x8000, 0x8001, 0xFFFF], dtype=torch.int32)[
+        None, None, :
+    ]
+    bits = ((exponents << 23) | (mantissas << 16) | tails).flatten()
+    bits = bits[bits <= 0x3F800000]
+    values = torch.cat((torch.zeros(1), bits.view(torch.float32)))
+    permutation = torch.randperm(
+        values.numel(), generator=torch.Generator().manual_seed(7183)
+    )
+    values = values[permutation].cuda()
+    probabilities = torch.empty_like(values, dtype=torch.bfloat16)
+    rounded = torch.empty_like(values)
+    convert[(triton.cdiv(values.numel(), block_m * 64),)](
+        values,
+        probabilities,
+        rounded,
+        values.numel(),
+        block_m,
+        num_warps,
+        num_warps=num_warps,
+    )
+    expected = values.bfloat16()
+    torch.testing.assert_close(probabilities, expected, rtol=0, atol=0)
+    torch.testing.assert_close(rounded, expected.float(), rtol=0, atol=0)
